ayahOccurrences.text: فَبَدَأَ بِأَوْعِيَتِهِمْ قَبْلَ وِعَآءِ أَخِيهِ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَخْرَجَهَا مِن وِعَآءِ أَخِيهِ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ كِدْنَا لِيُوسُفَ ۖ مَا كَانَ لِيَأْخُذَ أَخَاهُ فِى دِينِ ٱلْمَلِكِ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ نَرْفَعُ دَرَجَٰتٍ مَّن نَّشَآءُ ۗ وَفَوْقَ كُلِّ ذِى عِلْمٍ عَلِيمٌ

ayahOccurrences.text: لِنَجْعَلَهَا لَكُمْ تَذْكِرَةً وَتَعِيَهَآ أُذُنٌ وَٰعِيَةٌ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: لِنَجْعَلَهَا لَكُمْ تَذْكِرَةً وَتَعِيَهَآ أُذُنٌ وَٰعِيَةٌ

lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: بِأَوْعِيَتِهِمْ is in the derivative form: وِعَاءٌ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
و/ع/ي   w–ʿ–y vessel, container
; awareness, comprehension; noise; to collect, to gather, to comprise; to comprehend, to be aware, to be alert; (of a wound) to secrete; to exhaust.

Of this root, 5 forms occur 7 times in the Qur’an:
تَعِي taʿı 1 time; أَوْعَى ʾawʿā 2 times; وَاعِيَةٌ wāʿiyatun 1 time; وِعَاءٌ wiʿāʾ 2 times and أَوْعِيَةٌ ʾawʿiyatun 1 time.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
وِعَاءٌ wiʿāʾ [n. pl. أَوْعِيَةٌ ʾawʿiyatun] baggage, pack, travel gear

(12:76) فَبَدَأَ بِأَوْعِيَتِهِمْ قَبْلَ وِعَاءِ أَخِيهِ so he began with their packs before the pack of his brother.

entries.label: أَوْعَى
entries.definitionHtml:
أَوْعَى ʾawʿā [v. IV, trans.]

1 to keep from others, to hoard,

(70:18) وَجَمَعَ فَأَوْعَى amasses [wealth] and hoards it

2 to hide in one’s heart, to harbour

(84:23) وَاللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يُوعُونَ God knows best what they keep hidden inside [their hearts].

entries.label: تَعِي
entries.definitionHtml:
تَعِي taʿı [imperf. of v. وَعَى waʿā, trans.] to grasp, to perceive, to retain, to take in

(69:12) وَتَعِيَهَا أُذُنٌ وَاعِيَةٌ and attentive ears might take it in.

entries.label: وَاعِيَةٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
وَاعِيَةٌ wāʿiyatun [fem. act. part.] perceptive, attentive, grasping

(69:12) وَتَعِيَهَا أُذُنٌ وَاعِيَةٌ and attentive ears might take it in.
